topic.title: Random Color Walk
topic.description: Extends the random walk by generating a random RGB color for each step. Introduces colormode(255) and dynamic color generation.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Setting turtle.colormode(255) to use RGB values and generating three random integers (0–255) for each new color.
learningNotes.challenges: Remembering to set colormode before using RGB tuples.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Combine with varying step sizes for more organic patterns.

files.description: Random walk with dynamically generated RGB colors.
